title: 글자 블록 만들기: 세로 모음과 가로 모음
objective: By the end, you can build correct Hangul blocks and read blocks like 가, 고, 각 and 곡 aloud.
summary: Learn how the vowel's shape decides where the consonant goes in a Hangul block (가/고, 각/곡).

task.title: Build and read blocks
task.line: Look at the shape of the vowel to find where the consonant goes, then answer each item.

letters.sound: [ga] — vertical vowels ㅏ ㅓ ㅣ (also ㅑ ㅕ): the consonant goes on the LEFT
[go] — horizontal vowels ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ (also ㅛ ㅠ): the consonant goes ON TOP
letters.as: go, like 'go' but with no 'w' sound at the end

letters.sound: [gak] — a final consonant always goes at the BOTTOM
letters.as: like 'gak', with the k not fully released, as in 'backpack'

letters.sound: [gok] — horizontal vowel: consonant on top, vowel in the middle, final consonant at the bottom (three layers)
letters.as: like 'gok', with the k not fully released

exercises: Is the consonant on the left or on top? ① 노 ② 다 ③ 무 ④ 기
Put the pieces together into one block: ① ㅁ + ㅏ ② ㄷ + ㅜ ③ ㅂ + ㅗ + ㅁ ④ ㅅ + ㅓ + ㄴ
Split each block into its letters: ① 소 ② 문 ③ 감
Choose the block that matches the sound: ① [no] 나 / 노 ② [bok] 박 / 복 ③ [dal] 달 / 돌
answers: ① on top ② on the left ③ on top ④ on the left
① 마 ② 두 ③ 봄 ④ 선
① ㅅ + ㅗ ② ㅁ + ㅜ + ㄴ ③ ㄱ + ㅏ + ㅁ
① 노 ② 복 ③ 달
